propositions: A ticket declaring file_impact_scope: none must be validated to ensure the declared assertion is correct and actually describes work requiring no repository-file changes.

The no-file-impact criterion must be routed deterministically only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; other scope values (paths, undeclared, missing, None, unknown) must not trigger the criterion or incur LLM cost.
The criterion must produce an advisory contradiction finding when a deliverable requires repository-file edits (source, config, test, or docs); external-only work passes without finding.
When evidence is insufficient, the criterion produces non-blocking coaching requesting the author to name deliverables and explain why none requires repository-file edits.
The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON-serialized structured context in the Pass-1 LLM request, preserving quotes, newlines, Unicode, and empty-string values.
